note: Main sidebar chrome -- renders: user status, fixed icon buttons (Home, DMs, etc.), and separators; the rooms list is subtracted as it renders user-created channel names
Sidebar top bar -- renders: fixed section title (e.g. 'Channels') and fixed icon buttons
Sidebar section headers -- renders: fixed category labels (e.g. 'Favorites', 'Channels')
Sidebar footer -- renders: fixed platform logo
Sidebar user profile block -- renders: fixed profile link structure (avatar, name, status); the name/status are user-controlled but the container is the operator's profile widget
Room header -- renders: fixed action buttons (search, info, etc.); the room title heading is subtracted as it renders a user-created channel name
New message button -- renders: fixed label 'New message'
Jump to recent button -- renders: fixed label 'Jump to recent messages'
Message input footer -- renders: fixed message box controls, formatting toolbar buttons (Bold, Italic, etc.), and emoji picker; the text entry is a control, not content
